method: Saved-artifact-only H1 integrator synthesis from the specified context, literature, swarm, falsifier, and concept-evolve notes. No new broad search.

alias_resolution.reason: Duplicated startup paths and selector leakage push directly into the H1 overhead kill rule, and the framing drifts too close to existing low-voltage and assisted-startup prior art.
Local signature timing plus packet transfer overlaps the 2023-2024 multi-input extraction family too closely once equal energy accounting is enforced.

top_6.selection_reason: Only concept that keeps the H1 thesis intact: helper-free source scouting before the main arbiter is alive under heterogeneous ramp, impedance, and polarity conditions.
top_6.novelty_risk: Collapses if it behaves like ordinary priority OR-ing, threshold ranking, or another generic multi-input startup interface.
top_6.overhead_risk: Probe energy, sequencing delay, mirror mismatch, or any hidden precharge/helper behavior can erase the gain.
top_6.falsifier_constraint: Must beat fixed-path and non-source-aware multi-input startup under equal accounting, include mixed-polarity and 1:20 impedance cases, and avoid helper-rail behavior.

top_6.selection_reason: Best backup if mixed-polarity cold start remains the unresolved regime not covered by the closest recent multi-input piezo interfaces.
top_6.novelty_risk: Collapses if one bucket acts like a helper reservoir or if a simple rectifier or ideal-diode baseline removes the advantage.
top_6.overhead_risk: Two scout buckets, merge clamps, and cross-coupled control can dominate below 50 mV; leakage can erase polarity separation.
top_6.falsifier_constraint: Keep only if mixed-polarity cases remain central and merge-control energy stays below the startup benefit.

top_6.selection_reason: Cleanest low-overhead source-aware comparator for the required equal-accounting benchmark and ablation line.
top_6.novelty_risk: Too close to ordinary RC arbitration or adaptive startup to carry the headline claim by itself.
top_6.overhead_risk: Only defensible if RC ranking is materially cheaper than explicit compare-and-select logic.
top_6.falsifier_constraint: Keep as a benchmark family only; retire as a lead claim if it fails to improve startup benefit per control energy.

top_6.selection_reason: Useful anti-backdrive support block inside H1, but not strong enough to anchor the thesis.
top_6.novelty_risk: Anti-backdrive alone is already expected in multi-input interfaces, and leakage-vote sensing is easy to match with simpler isolation baselines.
top_6.overhead_risk: Windowing, latch stability, and calibration overhead can dominate the small reverse-current win.
top_6.falsifier_constraint: Keep only if it improves startup correctness rather than reverse-current cosmetics.

top_6.selection_reason: Useful only as a handoff stabilizer for H1 mixed-source startup, not as a standalone architecture claim.
top_6.novelty_risk: Reads like a refined POR or UVLO deglitcher unless tied to a distinctly multi-source failure mode.
top_6.overhead_risk: Token accumulation and reset energy can approach the same control budget as ordinary startup-control baselines.
top_6.falsifier_constraint: Keep only if it removes measured UVLO chatter or false handoff that conventional hysteresis does not.

top_6.selection_reason: Only valuable as the lowest-overhead implementation of packet scouting; otherwise it belongs inside the packet-scout family.
top_6.novelty_risk: Without a clear overhead advantage it is just another source-probing variant inside 001, and any need for precharge or hidden bias weakens the helper-free story immediately.
top_6.overhead_risk: Capacitor mismatch, injected-charge loss, and weak-source perturbation can consume the same budget as the RC ranker while corrupting the estimate.
top_6.falsifier_constraint: Keep only if it beats 003 on startup benefit per control energy without requiring precharge, sense amplification, or hidden bias.
